verdict.rationale: Inngest documents concurrency limits that can be scoped with keys, applying the limit to each unique value such as a user ID, which supports per-tenant caps. It also documents hard rate limits on function run starts, and its docs list concurrency, throttling and rate limiting as built-in flow control. missing for 10: explicit evidence that rate limits can be keyed per tenant, explicit documentation of per-function versus per-key scoping and of fairness that stops a hot tenant from starving others, independent or hands-on corroboration.
